subject: CedarPoint visit: scheduling options after travel change
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@cedarpointhealth.com>; it@cedarpointhealth.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed onsite demo Aug 24 — Redwood Inference

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for coordinating the CedarPoint site visit. Per our notes, we penciled in Tuesday, Aug 24 at 10:00 AM for a ~60 minute on-site demo + 30 minute Q&A with your engineering and procurement team. Attached is an updated agenda and the quick demo deck so folks can scan ahead.

Agenda highlights:
- 10:00 — Quick intros + success metrics overview
- 10:10 — Live demo: latency and cost controls, routing policies, and Dedicated mode
- 10:40 — Deep dive: security/compliance (VPC, audit logs) — for your IT
- 11:00 — Q&A and next steps

Attachments: agenda_redwood_v2.pdf (stub), demo-deck.pptx (stub). I can add a recording consent clause if you want us to record.

If anything in the agenda should shift to a different owner (e.g., procurement vs IT), let me know and I’ll update the invite. Otherwise I’ll send the calendar invite and add Lauren to the logistics thread.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@cedarpointhealth.com>

On Wed, Aug 19, 2026 at 9:12 AM Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Maya —
> 
> Thanks again for coordinating the CedarPoint site visit...

Alex — quick update from my side. We just had a scheduling ripple: our VP of Clinical Ops (leading this visit) was asked to attend an emergency partner meeting in Chicago and will now be traveling the week of Aug 22–26. That means the core decision-makers we planned for onsite won't be present on Aug 24.

Two asks:
1) Can you do the demo on a different day that week (Aug 27 is already bad for us) or the following week?
2) Alternatively, would you be able to keep Aug 24 but run it as a hybrid session where we join remote + you record the session so the leadership can watch later, followed by a shorter live office-hours slot?

We prefer to avoid losing momentum, so a hybrid option would be ideal if you can accommodate a recording and a follow-up office hours block with time for procurement questions.

I can confirm final attendees after I confirm travel details — attaching a short travel note.

Thanks — Maya
Maya Patel
Senior Program Manager, CedarPoint Health
maya.patel@cedarpointhealth.com
(312) 555-0199

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@cedarpointhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed onsite demo Aug 24 — Redwood Inference

On Wed, Aug 19, 2026 at 10:05 AM Maya Patel <maya.patel@cedarpointhealth.com> wrote:
> Alex — quick update from my side. We just had a scheduling ripple...

Thanks for the heads-up, Maya — totally understand. We can support either option; listing pros/cons to help you decide quickly: 

Option A — Move the onsite to Monday Aug 31 or Wed Sep 2 (we can bring the extended team and allow for an in-person workshop). Pros: full attendance, live whiteboarding, procurement sign-off run-through. Cons: delays decision timeline ~1 week.

Option B — Keep Aug 24, run hybrid (we host onsite demo + stream + record). We will:
- Record the full demo and share a time-stamped recording
- Run a 30-minute follow-up office-hours on Aug 26 (or a day you prefer) for procurement and leadership to ask targeted questions
- Provide a short recording release/consent stub for CedarPoint to sign (we treat the recording as shared artifacts only)

Logistics notes for Option B:
- We can place Ben on the on-site delivery team to handle AV/recording and to ensure your IT gets the network checklist.
- Lauren will handle calendar coordination and the invite with the recording link + meeting notes.

Next steps: Tell us which option you prefer and we’ll block time. If you go Option B, confirm preferred office-hours slot (Aug 25–27 window) and whether recording is OK. I’ve attached the recording-release.pdf template for your legal team to review.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
Attachments: recording-release.pdf (stub)

On Wed, Aug 19, 2026 at 11:40 AM Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the heads-up, Maya — totally understand...

Alex — thanks for the clear options. We prefer Option B (keep Aug 24 as hybrid + record). That keeps momentum for procurement. Quick confirmations:
- Recording is OK (I'll route the recording-release to legal).
- Office-hours: Aug 26, 9:00–9:30 AM CT works for our leadership (please confirm Redwood availability).
- Ben: please send a short AV/network checklist to our IT contact (it@cedarpointhealth.com) so our facilities team can prep the room.

I'll follow up with the final attendee list by Friday EOD. Please send the updated invite and recording details when you have them.

Best — Maya
Maya Patel
